summary: Improve shift control, HACCP routines and kitchen-to-service handoffs. Explore this practical five-day food and beverage operations course.
lede: Food and beverage operations coordinate safe food preparation, production planning and service delivery across kitchen and front-of-house teams. For restaurant supervisors, kitchen leads and catering coordinators, this training covers planning production against demand, mapping kitchen-to-service handoffs, reviewing food-safety records and communicating allergen information. Learners also practise tracking shift exceptions and turning service and safety reviews into prioritized improvement actions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who coordinate food preparation, food safety controls and service delivery, and who need to improve how a shift runs across kitchen and front-of-house teams.
modules: HACCP Checks Across the Food Flow
prerequisites: Bring practical exposure to restaurant, kitchen, hotel food service or catering operations. No coding or programming is required.
